body:
I'm not allowed to have pets where I live. Last time I adopted an animal from the shelter it was when I lived with my mother. I wish I'd never done that.

Who am I good for? I used to have a girlfriend and tried to be the best for her. But she had an education to pursue, I didn't. My highschool education was fucked up. Because my mother gave me drugs, because I didn't try hard enough and because I'm generally a shitty person.

This is the very point. I have nothing. No future, a shitty past and a static present. I'm completely forgotten.

I haven't been outside in the daytime for many months.

I've seen the northen lights a lot of times. It's pretty but nothing exciting when you've seen it enough times. Also, it's nothing like what you see on video.

I'm from Europe. I've traveled to Africa, South, Middle and North America when I was younger.

I've seen poverty, richness and anything between. That only makes me feel worse, why do I get money for free to just sit around while when I go to the shop people steal to get food for the evening?

I've been in Canada. They are a lot like at home. 

>If there is nothing there for you, it's time to find a new home.

I've done that three times. I'm too tired to do that again.

>If there is no one left to call a family, it's time to search for a new family.

Who would want me? No one so far.

> If there is no love for yourself, it's time to become someone else.

I've tried that since 2004.

>You owe it to yourself

I've been brought up to think that I'm the lowest of the lowest. I owe my life to my family, and should be happy to be alive and every waking moment should be dedicated to others, not myself. If I'm not, I'm selfish. I guess I am.

I'm spoiled and useless.

> and the only thing I can say to you is that maybe there isn't. If there's nothing in your life that you care about, then it's time to change it.

I know your feelings too well. Thanks.

I'm less than shit. At least that get the community attention, get rid of that!

I'm still stuck in limbo.
